बृहस्पतिचारः ८ ॥ JUPITER’S COURSE: नक्षत्रेण सहोदयं समुपगच्छति येन मन्दकिरणः । अब्दः स एव पुरतः प्रदिष्टवर्षैः क्रमान्नेयः ॥ १ ॥ कार्त्तिकादीनि वर्षाणि द्विसंयुक्तानि भानि तु । उपरिष्टात् त्रिभाष्यन्त्या वर्षा पञ्चममेव च ॥ २ ॥
Translation: Ascertain the star in which Jupiter reappears after conjunction with the Sun. That year of Jupiter will bear the name of that particular star, and the succeeding years those of the lunar months following it in regular order. Jupiter’s years commence from Karttika and consist of two asterisms each beginning with Krttika and follow in regular order. However, the 5th, 10th and 11th years comprise each three asterisms.

पौषे धान्यद्विगुणः सस्यो द्विगुणस्तथा भवेद् द्विविधः । द्वित्रिगुणो वा धान्यैः क्षेमकृदथोपशमकृच्च ॥ ७ ॥
Translation: In the Pausa year of Jupiter the world will be happy and prosperous, kings will be free from enmity among themselves, the prices of food grains will go up two-fold or three-fold, and preservative work will flourish. [Bhattotpala interprets as fall in prices of corn.]

पितृपूजारतिरधिका सन्तोषः सर्वभूतसुखमारोग्यम् । अनावृष्टिरनर्थकरी धान्यस्यार्घस्य वृद्धिः स्यात् ॥ ८ ॥
Translation: In the Magha year of Jupiter people would worship the manes with greater devotion, and all beings would enjoy happiness and contentment as well as sound health. There would be good rains and good prices for corn; and people would live with greater amity and cordiality.

गर्भलक्षणम् २१ ॥ PREGNANCY OF CLOUDS: अन्नं जगतः प्राणाः प्रावृट्कालस्य चान्नमायत्तम् । यस्मादतश्चिन्त्यः प्रावृट्कालः प्रयत्नेन ॥ १ ॥ येन विना यन्नास्ति न तज्ज्ञैस्तत्प्रकाश्यते कस्मात् । कस्मादथ भूपाला न भवन्ति प्रजाश्च सुखभाजः ॥ २ ॥
Translation: As food forms the very life of living beings, and as food is dependent on the monsoon, it should be investigated carefully. What is the use of declaring that an effect is not produced without its cause? Why are kings not free from anxiety, and why are subjects not happy?

मार्गशिरसितपक्षप्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्षपाकरे विशति । पूर्वाषाढां यो गर्भः स भवति सुफलः प्रवृद्धिश्च ॥ ६ ॥
Translation: The pregnancy of clouds formed when the Moon enters the asterism of Purvasadha commencing from the first day of the bright fortnight of the month of Margasirsa, yields abundant rain and increases welfare.

यन्नक्षत्रे गर्भो यस्मिन् मासर्क्षसम्भवः साहे । पञ्चनवत्यधिकेऽह्नां शते तदेव प्रसवमेति ॥ १२ ॥
Translation: The day on which the pregnancy is formed in a particular constellation and fortnight, delivers rain after 195 days (panchanavaty-adhike ahnam sate) when the Moon is in the very same constellation.

गर्भधारणम् २२ ॥ RETENTION OF EMBRYO: प्रावृट्कालेऽपि गर्भेषु केचिदाहुर्विशेषतः । पवनादीन् गुणान् दृष्ट्वा प्रसवो विनिदिश्यते ॥ १ ॥
Translation: In the monsoon season also, some ancient teachers state, after observing the symptoms of wind and clouds, the retention of the embryo of rain is diagnosed for its future delivery.

प्रवर्षणाध्यायः २३ ॥ RAINFALL: हस्तविस्तारं कुण्डकमुदकप्रमाणं च धारयेत् समे देशे । तस्मिन् दृष्टे तोये ज्ञेयं प्रवर्षितं कियत् ॥ १ ॥ पञ्चाशत्पलं द्रोणः षोडशनिकेतनाढकैर्युक्तः । द्रोणैश्चतुर्भिस्तु भवेत् खाण्डिका प्रकीर्तिता ॥ २ ॥
Translation: A round vessel with a diameter of one cubit and depth of one span should be placed on level ground. When rain falls into it, the quantity of rainfall should be measured. Fifty palas make one Adhaka, four Adhakas make one Drona. Twenty-five dronas make one Khandika of rainfall.

रोहिणीयोगाध्यायः २४ ॥ THE MOON’S CONJUNCTION WITH ROHINI: आषाढशुक्लपक्षे रोहिण्या सह शशाङ्कयोगेऽपि । विज्ञेयं जगति फलं पवनस्य गतिप्रचारैश्च ॥ १ ॥
Translation: In the bright fortnight of the lunar month of Asadha, when the Moon conjoins the asterism Rohini, the future welfare of the world and rainfall should be determined from the direction and nature of the wind that blows at that time.

स्वातीयोगाध्यायः २५ ॥ THE MOON’S CONJUNCTION WITH SVATI: आषाढीपूर्णिमायां यदा स्वात्या युज्यते शशी । वर्षलक्षणमालोक्य सर्वज्ञैस्तत् प्रकाशितम् ॥ १ ॥
Translation: On the full Moon day of the month of Asadha, when the Moon conjoins the asterism Svati, the symptoms of rainfall should be examined as declared by omniscient sages.

आषाढीयोगाध्यायः २६ ॥ THE MOON’S CONJUNCTION WITH ASADHA: आषाढमासस्य तु पौर्णमास्यां नक्षत्रयोगः कथितो मुनीन्द्रैः । तत्रापि वर्षं प्रति विज्ञेयं लोकस्य च सुखप्रदं स्यात् ॥ १ ॥
Translation: On the full Moon day of the month of Asadha, the conjunction of the Moon with the asterisms has been explained by great sages, through which rainfall and happiness of the world should be predicted.

वातचक्राध्यायः २७ ॥ THE WIND CIRCLE: प्राच्यादिदिक्स्थे मरुति क्रमेण वृष्टिप्रणाशौ च भयं सुखं च । आषाढमासे समवेक्ष्य धीमान् प्रावृट्प्रमाणं कथितं मुनीन्द्रैः ॥ १ ॥
Translation: When the wind blows from the east and other cardinal points in order during the month of Asadha, there will be rainfall, destruction, fear, and happiness respectively. The wise observer should deduce the quantum of monsoon rain from this circle.

सद्योवृष्ट्यध्यायः २८ ॥ SIGNS OF IMMEDIATE RAIN: सूर्येन्दूदयवेलायां ग्रहाणां मण्डलेष्वपि । चिन्त्या सद्यःप्रवृष्टिश्च प्रावृट्काले विजानता ॥ १ ॥
Translation: At the time of sunrise and sunset, and around planetary orbs, the signs of immediate rainfall should be examined during the rainy season by the knowledgeable astrologer.

भूकम्पलक्षणाध्यायः ३२ ॥ SIGNS OF EARTHQUAKE: क्षितिकम्पमाहुरेके बृहदुदकनिवासिसत्त्वसङ्क्षोभात् । अनिलेन चानिलकृतं महता वा भूमिविवरेषु ॥ १ ॥
Translation: Some Sages hold that an earthquake is brought about by the huge animals living in the waters of the ocean, while others opine that it is caused by the collision of mighty underground winds in subterranean cavities.

उत्तराभाद्रपदोत्तराषाढोत्तराफाल्गुनीरोहिणीमृगशिरोविशाखासु पवनमण्डले कम्पः । स च द्विशतयोजनानि कम्पयति ॥ ८ ॥
Translation: When an earthquake occurs in the Wind Mandala (Vayavya Mandala, comprising Uttarabhadrapada, Uttarasadha, Uttaraphalguni, Rohini, Mrgasiras, and Visakha), its shock extends to a distance of two hundred yojanas.

द्रव्यनिश्चयाध्यायः ४१ ॥ CLASSIFICATION OF SUBSTANCES: ये येषां द्रव्याणामधिपतयो भवन्ति राशयः प्रसूताः । मुनिभिः पृथक्प्रणीता व्याख्यास्यामः सहेतुमहम् ॥ १ ॥ मेषे कनकरत्नानि लोहं चैव प्रकीर्तितम् । वृषभे धान्यवस्त्राणि मिथुने कांस्यभूषणे ॥ २ ॥
Translation: I shall now expound, on the authority of the Sastras, the different Zodiacal Signs that have been declared by ancient Sages as the rulers of different substances, so that their good and bad effects on prices may be understood. In Aries (Mesa) are assigned gold (kanaka), jewels and iron; in Taurus grains and clothes; in Gemini bronze and ornaments.

सौम्यैर्दृष्टे युक्ते वा स्वर्घता तस्य निर्दिशेत् । क्रूरैर्विनाशः कथितो धान्यद्रव्यादिसञ्चये ॥ १२ ॥
Translation: When the sign ruling a commodity is aspected or conjoined by benefic planets (Jupiter, Venus, unafflicted Mercury), the price of that substance will be cheap/moderate (svarghta) and supplies abundant; when aspected or conjoined by malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu), its destruction or extreme dearness occurs.

अर्घकाण्डकाध्यायः ४२ ॥ FLUCTUATION OF PRICES: अतिवृष्टिरुल्का दण्डो परिवेषो ग्रहणं तथा प्रतिसूर्यः । सङ्क्रान्तिदिने दृष्ट्वा ज्ञेयार्घस्य विवृद्धिर्वा ॥ १ ॥
Translation: By observing excessive rain, meteor, staff (danda), halo, eclipse, mock-sun and such other portents on the new-Moon and full-Moon days and also at the Sun’s entrance into a new Sign of the Zodiac (Samkranti) every month, one should predict fluctuations in the prices of commodities.

षोडशवर्गाध्यायः ६ ॥ NAMES OF THE 16 VARGAS: होरादृक्काणसहिता भागाः सप्तांशकास्तथा । नवांशका दशांशाश्च द्वादशांशास्तथैव च ॥ २ ॥ षोडशांशा विंशांशाश्च चतुर्विंशांशकास्ततः । भांशाश्च त्रिंशांशाश्च खवेदांशास्तथैव च ॥ ३ ॥ अक्षवेदांशकाश्चैव षष्ट्यंशाश्च क्रमादिह । षोडश वर्गाः प्रोक्ताश्च ब्रह्मणोक्ता महात्मना ॥ ४ ॥
Translation: NAMES OF THE 16 VARGAS: Lord Brahma has described 16 kinds of Vargas (Divisions) for each sign. Listen to those. The same are: Rasi, Hora, Drekkana, Chaturthamsa, Saptamamsa, Navamsa, Dasamamsa, Dvadasamsa, Shodasamsa, Vimsamsa, Chaturvimsamsa, Saptavimsamsa, Trimsamsa, Khavedamsa, Akshavedamsa and Shashtiamsa.

क्षेत्रं च राशिरुच्यते तदर्धं होरा प्रकीर्तिता । ओजे सूर्येन्दुहोरे स्तो युग्मे तु शशिसूर्ययोः ॥ ५ ॥
Translation: RASI AND HORA: The Rasi owned by a planet is called its Kshetra (one sign). The first half of an odd sign is the Hora ruled by the Sun while the second half is the Hora of the Moon. The reverse is true in the case of an even sign. Half of Rasi is called Hora. These are totally 24 counted from Aries.

नवांशकास्तु चरभे तस्मादेवावधारयेत् । स्थिरभे नवमाच्चैव द्विस्वभावे च पञ्चमात् ॥ १२ ॥
Translation: NAVAMSA: The Navamsas in movable signs commence from the sign itself; in fixed signs from the 9th sign therefrom; and in common (dual) signs from the 5th sign therefrom. Each Navamsa is one ninth of a Rasi (3° 20'). The presiding deities are Deva, Nara and Rakshasa repeating consecutively.

दशांशकाश्च चरभे तस्मादेव प्रकीर्तिताः । युग्मे नवमतः प्रोक्ता दशांशेशाः क्रमादमी ॥ १५ ॥
Translation: DASAMSA: The counting of Dasamsas (one tenth of a sign or 3°) in an odd sign commences from the very sign, while in an even sign it commences from the 9th sign therefrom. The lords of the ten directions (Indra, Agni, Yama, Nirriti, Varuna, Vayu, Kubera, Isana, Brahma, Ananta) rule them.

दशाध्याये ४६ ॥ DASAS (PERIODS) OF PLANETS: विंशोत्तरी दशेहैका बहुधा कथिता बुधैः । अष्टोत्तरी तथा चान्या षोडशोत्तरी परा ॥ २ ॥
Translation: The Sage replied: O Brahmin! Dasas (periods) are of many kinds. Amongst them Vimsottari is the most appropriate for the general populace. But the other Dasas followed in special cases are Astottari, Shodasottari, Dwadasottari, Panchottari, Satabdika, Chaturashitisama, Dwisaptatisama, Shastihayani, Shatvimsatsama... based on nakshatras.

विंशोत्तरीदशा ॥ कृत्तिकाद्याश्च ये नक्षत्रास्तेषां दशाविभाजनम् । रविरिन्दुर्महीपुत्रो राहुर्जीवः शनैश्चरः ॥ १२ ॥ बुधः केतुः सितश्चेति दशाधीशाः प्रकीर्तिताः । नवांशेन च संविभज्य शेषं दशाधिपं विदुः ॥ १३ ॥
Translation: VIMSOTTARI DASA: Beginning from Krittika the lords of Dasas (periods) are the Sun, the Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury, Ketu and Venus in that order. Thus if the nakshatras from Krittika to the Janma Nakshatra (natal constellation) are divided by nine, the remainder will signify the lord of the commencing Dasa. In Kaliyuga the natural life span of a human being is generally taken as 120 years. Therefore, Vimsottari Dasa is considered to be the most appropriate and the best of all Dasas.

रवेः षड् वर्षाणि चन्द्रे दश कुजे च सप्त च । अष्टादश च राहौ च गुरोः षोडश एव च ॥ १५ ॥ एकोनविंशतिः शौरेः सप्तदश बुधस्य च । केतोः सप्त सितायाश्च विंशतिर्वर्षाणि संस्मरेत् ॥ १६ ॥
Translation: PERIODS OF PLANETS: The Dasa periods (in years) allotted to the planets are: the Sun 6, the Moon 10, Mars 7, Rahu 18, Jupiter 16, Saturn 19, Mercury 17, Ketu 7, and Venus 20. The total of all these periods is 120 years.

भुक्तांशेन च सम्गुण्य दशेषांशं समाहृतम् । भोगेनापहृते लब्धं भुक्तवर्षादिकं भवेत् ॥ १७ ॥
Translation: CALCULATION OF BALANCE OF DASA: Multiply the total span of the Dasa of the planet concerned by the unexpired portion of the constellation (in minutes) and divide the product by 800 (the total measure of a nakshatra in minutes). The quotient will represent the balance of the Dasa at birth in years, months and days.
